content.title: Cracker Barrel Cuts Corporate Staff
content.summary: Cracker Barrel is laying off several dozen corporate employees as the family-dining chain seeks to trim expenses following plunging sales.  The Lebanon, Tenn.-based chain notified corporate employees of the layoffs Thursday.  Cracker Barrel said during an investor call in December that it was seeking to save $20 million to $25 million in annual spending by streamlining its corporate support center, including through layoffs during the current quarter.
